title: Halloween II
description:
S1
A killer follows his injured target (Jamie Lee Curtis) to the hospital on Oct. 31 in Haddonfield, Ill.

title: House of Dracula
description:
S1
A scientist (Onslow Stevens) helps the Wolf Man (Lon Chaney) and Dracula (John Carradine), and revives Frankenstein's monster.

title: House of Frankenstein
description:
S1
A mad doctor (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked helper (J. Carrol Naish) revive Dracula, the Wolf Man (Lon Chaney) and the Frankenstein monster.

title: House of Horrors
description:
S1
An insane sculptor sends the disfigured criminal he saved from drowning to kill the critics who denounced him.

title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
description:
S1
Exposure to a mysterious fog causes a man (Grant Williams) to shrink, making the world around him extremely hazardous.

title: The Invisible Man
description:
S1
The serum that makes a scientist (Claude Rains) invisible has madness as a side effect.

title: The Invisible Man Returns
description:
S1
A man (Vincent Price) framed for murder uses a serum to become invisible, then escapes to find the killer.

title: The Invisible Man's Revenge
description:
S1
A criminal (Jon Hall) haunts his enemies' mansion after a mad scientist (John Carradine) makes him invisible.

title: The Invisible Ray
description:
S1
A scientist (Bela Lugosi) seeks an antidote for a radium-poisoned colleague (Boris Karloff) with the touch of death.

title: The Invisible Woman
description:
S1
A screwy professor's experiments with a gorgeous model attract the attentions of a gangster and a handsome millionaire.
